svg.title: sand-agent: a live agent chat about Kyle Touchet, typed from public GitHub history
svg.desc: Q: hey, who's Sand? Kyle Touchet, better known around here as Sand. Software Engineer and Creative Technologist. Over ten years in IT operations and federal-sector administration, now designing and shipping production web, desktop and AI applications end to end. The headline act is LadderStar: a live AI interview platform with a real-time, voice-to-voice audition room built on Google's Gemini Multimodal Live API. Q: is Sand open to work? Yes. Sand is looking for work right now, as a software engineer or creative technologist. The pitch: production web, desktop and AI apps shipped end to end, on top of ten years of IT operations and federal-sector work handling sensitive identity data under strict privacy rules. Say hi at kyletouchet@gmail.com or kyletouchet.dev. Q: tell me something fun about Sand Has been a notary public and a passport acceptance agent at a U.S. embassy. Has worked at U.S. embassies in three countries: Panama, Cyprus and Honduras. Kept Autodesk Backburner render farms running for a game studio. Q: more fun facts? Did IT for a casino, where compliance meant state gaming regulations. Deployed an entire network, servers and all, for a company acquisition. Built a dog bloodwork guide with profiles for 70+ breeds. Q: what else should people know? Studied game and simulation programming, then went on to ship real game mods. Q: tell me more about LadderStar LadderStar (ladderstar.com) is a live AI interview platform. Candidates audition in a real-time, voice-to-vo…
